scope: estimate from the ARM build run under an instruction-accurate emulator; the Teensy's DWT cycle counter replaces it at the bench check

build.note: Teensy's PlatformIO toolchain (gcc 11.3) was not reachable from the build host; the Debian arm-none-eabi gcc 13.2 stands in
build.memory_note: the weights are const: Teensy 4.0's linker copies them to DTCM (RAM1, 512 KB shared with ITCM) unless marked PROGMEM, leaving them in QSPI flash behind the 32 KB cache

cycle_model.basis: Cortex-M7 dual issue and FP add/multiply latency (ARM Cortex-M7 TRM); one accumulator chain per output; DTCM zero wait state
